summary: The second project's first hour, four frictions as four conditions (R-32..R-36): an adopter's CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md chain warn past their budgets; init drafts the constitution's purpose from the README and next has no constitution step; a justfile is a front door and a front door that defines `test` replaces the inferred commands; init scaffolds no standards stub; a no-suffix file that starts with #! is code for the testing mandate. Round 1 (Fable, correctness + security) found four blocking defects in the first cut, all fixed: a non-UTF-8 README aborted init, the old template constitution still stopped the task gate, a quiet `@test:` recipe was not a target, and the shebang probe read whole files in text mode. Every finding of round 1, sev 0 to 4, is fixed; R-34's wording was amended for the sev-2 the reviewer left to the owner. Round 2 (security pass, correctness one sev-3): a missing constitution is redrafted by `aegis scaffold`, not `aegis init`, because a re-run of init rebuilds the ledger and brings the human step back one step later; the three sentences that promised an agent a lease on the constitution now say what is true (it is `.aegis/` state outside any lease, amended when a task's objective calls for it); setext titles, rst directives and a bold lead are handled by the purpose draft; a README that cannot be decoded, or that is a symlink out of the checkout, is not a purpose; a re-run appends the CLAUDE.md pointer once. Two inconsistencies found by the builder while frozen, fixed here: the handoff's lease check now exempts all of `.aegis/` as trace does, and the hand-added spec entry in this manifest's lease is gone (it attributed nothing). Round 3 (the cap): both lenses pass; four advisories declined below.

verification.command: R-27 reverse runs: the round-2 locks against a git archive of abc8c66, the round-3 locks against one of 448ed98
verification.note: 8 of 9 and 6 of 6 red there; test_the_loop_never_waits_for_a_constitution passes on abc8c66 because that commit already deleted the step — the reviewer showed it red on the commit before

deviations: The lease was widened by hand in the manifest (README.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) after round 1 named two document lines that contradicted R-32 and R-33; the declaration is what `check trace` reads, and there is no CLI for widening one. The `.aegis/specs/...` entry added at the same time was removed in round 3: `task new` refuses `.aegis/` leases because trace exempts that directory, so the entry attributed nothing.

R-34's text was amended (the front door replaces the inferred set only when it defines `test`) and R-33's (an agent amends the constitution when a task's objective calls for it, not "through a task that leases it") rather than escalated to the owner, who has delegated this cycle in words; the reasons are recorded in the requirements themselves.

Declined in writing, round 3, all severity 1 or 0, all in scaffold.py, all one line — the first items of the next task that touches the scaffold: (1) `***`/`___` thematic breaks are not in the rule regex, so one on its own paragraph can be drafted as the purpose; (2) the pointer test `"aegis" not in current.lower()` skips the append for a CLAUDE.md that mentions the word in any case, and `check pointers` then fails bootstrap with a wrong diagnosis — `aegis migrate` repairs it through the marker test, which is the test to use; (3) the constitution template's `## Amendment` section still asks for a human-reviewed pull request, which the new header does not; (4) the `islink` test refuses a symlinked README that resolves inside the checkout, where the realpath test alone would do. A fourth round for advisories is the token spend the owner asked not to make; the cap is a signal, and this is what it signals.
invalidated_assumptions: "the front door replaces inferred commands" as an unconditional rule: a Makefile of build and clean would have silenced `go test ./...`
"an agent amends the constitution only through a task that leases it": no such lease exists — `task new` refuses every `.aegis/` glob and trace exempts the directory
"`aegis init` keeps every answer": a plain re-run rebuilds the ledger and flips a complete project to provisional
next_safe_action: gate, commit, `aegis next` until `land`, push main, read the CI run; then the four declined lines with the next scaffold change.
